configurePresets.name: msvc-ninja-debug
configurePresets.description: v2 engine, debug. Must be run from a vcvars64 environment -- CMake's Ninja generator invokes cl.exe directly and does not set one up itself. scripts/build.ps1 (Task 2) does this for you, mirroring interface/scripts/ninja-build.ps1's vcvars discovery. Floor is 3.28 (not lower) because vendor/CMakeLists.txt's benchmark/yaml-cpp FetchContent_Declare calls use EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, added in CMake 3.28; this field enforces that at preset-load time instead of letting an older CMake fail confusingly mid-configure. No CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD cache variable here (dropped, Task 21): it would be shadowed by the root CMakeLists.txt's own non-cache set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20) for v1, exactly the reason .github/workflows/spade.yml's configure lines drop the same flag; real C++23 enforcement is per-target target_compile_features(... PUBLIC cxx_std_23) in engine/CMakeLists.txt regardless.
